home_title: Guess the Speed | The Internet Speed Guessing Game for Families
home_description: A free family game and two-minute filler: everyone guesses the Wi-Fi download and upload speed, then a real speed test reveals who came closest. Play on one screen or on everyone's phone.

classroom_page_title: Classroom Mode: A Free Internet Speed Game for Teachers
classroom_page_description: A free internet speed game for teachers. Build a private class roster, make balanced teams or spotlight students, then guess a real speed test together on one shared screen.
classroom_page_hero_lede: Turn your students' speed guesses into a quick, lively class game.
classroom_page_hero_privacy: Your class list never leaves this device.
classroom_page_class_intro: Keep a roster here, then pick how today's class will play.

classroom_page_privacy_copy: Your roster remains in this browser's local storage. Classroom Mode does not create a room or send student names to the server. Clearing this site's data deletes the roster. Export a class file to move it to another device.
classroom_page_faq_answer_1: Yes. Classroom Mode is free to use, needs no account, and runs on the teacher's device.
classroom_page_faq_answer_2: The roster stays in this browser's local storage. Classroom Mode does not send student names to the server.
classroom_page_faq_question_3: How many students can I add to a class?
classroom_page_faq_answer_3: A class can have up to 40 students.
classroom_page_faq_question_4: Do students need their own devices?
classroom_page_faq_answer_4: No. One teacher device connected to a projector or shared screen is enough.
work_page_title: Guess the Wi-Fi: A Free Icebreaker Game for Remote Teams
work_page_description: A free virtual team building game and remote meeting icebreaker. Play a five-minute Wi-Fi guessing game from a shared link, with no accounts.
work_page_hero_lede: A free five-minute icebreaker for standups, all-hands, and offsites. No accounts: start a room and share its meeting link so everyone can play from their own device.
work_page_hero_note: Each round runs on a different teammate's connection.
work_page_room_kicker: Bring the room into your meeting
work_page_room_copy: Share one link in the call chat. Everyone guesses privately, then the test moves to a teammate's device each round.
work_page_steps_intro: Give the team one small thing to guess before the next agenda item.
work_page_step_1: The host shares the room link in the call chat.
work_page_step_2: Everyone picks a face and locks in a private guess.
work_page_step_3: The test hops to the next teammate each round.
work_page_office_copy_after: in the room bar and the host screen keeps running the test. The team can still take turns guessing together.
work_page_why_title: Why it works as an icebreaker
work_page_why_copy: Everyone has an opinion about their Wi-Fi. It is familiar, quick to explain, and gives the whole call a reason to compare guesses without turning a meeting into another long activity.
work_page_privacy_copy: No accounts are needed. Guesses stay hidden until the reveal. The tester's measured speed is shown to the room. Rooms are deleted after six hours without activity, and the game is not tied to anyone in its stats.
work_page_faq_answer_1: Yes. Work mode is free, needs no account, and works from a room link you can share in your meeting chat.
work_page_faq_answer_2: No. Teammates join from the room link or code, choose a face, and add a nickname. There is no sign-up.
work_page_faq_answer_3: A room supports up to {limit} players.
work_page_faq_question_4: Does the game share my location or IP with teammates?
work_page_faq_answer_4: No. Your location and IP address are not shown to teammates. The room shares only the speed numbers measured for that round.
